claims: Obtain arterial blood gas to further evaluate acid-base status (bicarbonate 14–18 mEq/L, anion gap 12–15, venous pH 7.30).
Continue frequent blood glucose monitoring and insulin therapy for persistent hyperglycemia (fingerstick glucose 222–280 mg/dL).
Recheck serum magnesium and consider magnesium repletion given level of 2.1 mg/dL on diuretic/insulin therapy.
Recheck serum phosphorus and consider enteral phosphate repletion given hypophosphatemia (0.9–1.2 mg/dL).
Recheck serum potassium and continue potassium repletion given level of 3.5 mEq/L.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit for anemia (hemoglobin 10.8–11.2 g/dL, hematocrit 33%).
Monitor temperature and signs of infection given leukocytosis (WBC 10.7–12.6 K/uL) and low-grade temperature (99.1°F).
Continue continuous cardiac monitoring and telemetry for rate control and ST segment monitoring (heart rate 98–102 bpm).
Perform fall risk assessment and implement fall precautions given chairfast/bed rest status and IV access.
Maintain current ICU level of care and monitoring.
